title: Edmund and the Gravity
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Jude Sandoval, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
